Callout.Name: Hillside Grass Fire
Callout.Message: Grass fire spreading on a hillside above houses.
Callout.Advisory: Wind towards the houses, no evacuation yet.

Script.Line: It is going up the hill rather than across. That is something.
If the wind turns it comes down onto the gardens.
Everybody on the top road has been told to leave. Not all of them have.

Lines.Approach: It is going uphill towards the houses and the wind is helping it. That is the whole job.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
